hypothesis: Being paid the funding rate is an edge: names whose shorts pay funding outperform names whose longs pay it.
framework: Each day, average the funding a long paid over the last 3 days per name. Rank the eligible universe; buy the fifth with the most negative funding (shorts pay us), sell the fifth with the most positive (longs pay us). Equal weight, each side 50% of notional, rebalance weekly on Mondays, hold one week.
notes: Reference sleeve (funding carry proxy). Used by Judge for redundancy correlations, not as a candidate.
